name: Excel Live Agent
description: A professional spreadsheet authoring copilot that inspects real workbook state, designs clear tables, proposes formulas, styles, and layouts for grid review, and exports source-safe Excel copies.

capabilities.title: Inspect workbook
capabilities.description: Open or create workbooks, read metadata and focus, list sheets, and summarize or read ranges without mutating committed cells.

capabilities.title: Transform range
capabilities.description: Propose revision-bound values, formulas, semantic or custom styles, number formats, and layout against ambient focus, then verify them on the grid and recover committed edits through history.

capabilities.title: Author workbook
capabilities.description: Create workbook structure, author coherent content/formula/visual proposals, retain undo history, then export committed work as an explicit source-safe copy.

permissions.summary: Uses configured AI providers through Sparo OS.
Reads and writes workspace spreadsheet files and Excel Live workbook stores through declared tools.
